question: Out of every 100 of sales, how much is left after product cost, shipping and payment fees?
explanation: This is your contribution margin. Say the shop sells 100 in a week and 60 goes on what the products cost you, shipping and payment fees: the answer is 40. Count refused cash-on-delivery parcels and returns in it too. We use it to turn extra sales into extra profit, so the proof never shows a profit we made up. Until you answer, the proof shows revenue only.
